decision.explanation: The Revolutionary Left Movement (MIR) refers to two distinct entities in the provided sources: one in Bolivia and one in Peru. The Bolivian Revolutionary Left Movement (MIR) was founded in 1971 (D1S3) and more specifically on 7 September 1971 (D2S2). These are distinct valid answers for the same referent. The 1962 founding date (D3S1) refers to the Peruvian Revolutionary Left Movement, a separate entity. The 12 October 1965 date (D6S4) refers to the Chilean MIR, another distinct entity. Only the Bolivian MIR is relevant to the question as phrased.
